name: Anomaly-ShapeNet: 3D Point Cloud Anomaly Detection Benchmark
description: Large-scale 3D point cloud anomaly detection benchmark derived from ShapeNetCore, comprising 1,600 point cloud models across 40 object categories (later expanded to 50 categories). Features five distinct types of synthesized physical anomalies (bulge, concavity, crack, hole, and broken parts) with point-level ground truth binary masks for benchmarking self-supervised 3D anomaly detection and localization.
